envelope.description: Correlate Claude requests and native completion

body.title: Correlate Claude requests and native completion
body.summary: Generate claude-request-UUID turn identity and stream-json user input over existing writable stdin; preserve launch options and permission control input. Classify new-turn Claude result completion by exact singular/list UUID correlation for live and resume, never by result order or heuristics. Preserve own result failures/empty completion and process-scoped lease/stop behavior, checkpoint handled terminal lines, and report missing trustworthy completion or input errors without duplicate retry. Adapt existing fixtures to dynamic request IDs and add failing-before/passing-after queued-result regressions.
acceptanceChecks: Multiple earlier results including zero queued count and prior failures cannot truncate real assistant/tool/final reply in live pipe/file and correlated resume.
Own singular or merged-list result, including empty/failed/zero-turn result, completes once while process remains alive without killing it.
Prompt JSON preserves leading dashes, Unicode/newlines and resume/permission/read-dir/allowed-tool options; stdin decision relay remains usable.
Missing/throwing stdin, malformed/missing correlation and clean/nonzero exit produce clear failures rather than false success or duplicated submissions.
Identity survives midstream reload; ignored/terminal cursor progress is correct.
Dynamic UUID fixture marks only designated own results, leaving earlier/malformed/uncorrelated results intact; original adapter demonstrably fails the premature-result regression.

tests.name: only designated request UUID singular/list result ends new Claude turn
earlier empty/failed/uncorrelated results retain real assistant/tool reply
own empty/error result returns before process exit without kill
stream input preserves prompt/options and permission relay; input/EOF failures
file/pipe live and midstream correlated reattach checkpoint handling
